We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

items.name: Back to Bishkek 2024
items.information: **Русский** Back to Bishkek 2024 - это открытый чемпионат по скоростной сборке головоломок в городе Бишкек. Базовый регистрационный взнос за любое количесвто дисциплин составляет 500 сом. Данные соревнования организованы при поддержки команды QBERS. **Кыргызча** Back to Bishkek 2024 - Бишкек шаарында жогорку ылдамдыктагы пазл чогултуу боюнча ачык чемпионат. Каалаган дисциплиналар үчүн негизги каттоо төлөмү 500 сомду түзөт. Бул мелдештер QBERS командасынын колдоосу менен уюштурулууда. **English** Back to Bishkek 2024 is a speedcubing competiton in Bishkek city. The base registration fee for any number of event is 500 som. This competiton is organized with the QBERS team help.

items.information: (BR) **Bem-vindos à segunda competição oficial de Morro Reuter!** Enquanto a maioria das pessoas viaja às praias no verão, a ideia de trazer a população cubista para um lugar calmo e tranquilo na Serra Gaúcha deu origem ao Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024! A oferta dessa competição é para aproveitar o período de férias longe do stress e tumulto das praias e grandes centros urbanos, trazendo desafios em Gincana interativa, com atividades que desenvolvam o trabalho em equipes e a melhor interação entre os competidores, especialmente crianças do Sul do Brasil. Nos vemos lá! (EN) **Welcome to the second official competition in Morro Reuter!** While most people travel to the beach during the summer, the idea of bringing the speedcubing community to a quiet and peaceful place in tthe Gaucho highlands gave birth to *Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024*! The proposition of this competition is to take advantage of the holiday season, far from the stress and chaos of the beaches and great urban centres, bringing challenges in an interactive contest, with activities that develop teamwork and the best interaction among the competitors, especially the children from Southern Brazil. See you there!

venue.name: University of Southern California
venue.address: TCC B41, 3607 Trousdale Pkwy, Los Angeles, CA 90089

items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/USCCubing2024#17574-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. Individuals with disabilities who need accommodations to attend this event may contact West Coast Cubing. It is requested that individuals requiring accommodations or auxiliary aids such as sign language interpreters and alternative format materials notify us at least 7 days prior to the event. Every reasonable effort will be made to provide reasonable accommodations in an effective and timely manner. We expect that all minors will be accompanied by a parent/guardian. ![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://i.imgur.com/hzQLmh7.png)

items.information: If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. This is a one-day competition with a heavy focus on relaxed 6x6, 7x7 and Megaminx time limits, so if you've always wanted to get an average in any of these events, this is the competition for you! Parents, if you're brave enough, you are more than welcome to give it a go!
